portfolio.title: Winnie's Flying Guide
portfolio.description: Winnie's Flying Guide is a poetry picture book for children ages 4 to 6 explores themes of belinging and friendship. It is most about the flying lessons of Winnie Pendragon, the good witch of East Winds, privately published for family and friends.

portfolio.title: Squid Captain & Sailorboy's Adventures
portfolio.description: A children's cover book illustration concept I made for Escolinha São José (St. Joseph Elementary School).

portfolio.title: Safari Wallpaper
portfolio.description: In January 2024, I worked with Fino Toque, an interior design company based in Recife, Brazil, which asked me to illustrate a bunch of children's wallpapers for a sale catalogue. I spent a short time there to create a few illustrations in three themes: Safari, Teddy Bears, and Kitten Patterns.

portfolio.title: School Children's Decoration
portfolio.description: A series of illustrations created to decorate the elementary school corridors across all seven GGE school campuses, located in the states of Pernambuco and Paraíba in Northeastern Brazil. Conceived as a tribute to the region's greatest artists, this series of 84 illustrations was produced between June and November 2025.

portfolio.title: Webcomic Travelers
portfolio.description: Anne always felt like an ordinary girl, with ordinary aspirations livin her ordinary life. Nothing really special happened during the first 20 years of her existence, but bumping a strange grumpy woman wearing a lab coat, everything changes. Timeless Journey is a webcomic I'm creating as the continuation of my undergraduate thesis project 'TRAVELERS'. It is being updated on Tapas.

portfolio.title: Sketching Comics
portfolio.description: Some illustrations and comic strips I created, including 'CAMAROTE DA VACINA NÃO' ('No Vaccine VIP Box')—a strip that criticized a proposed bill prioritizing early COVID-19 vaccine doses for business owners and CEOs over people in high-risk groups.

portfolio.title: Youtube Illustration Pack
portfolio.description: Evandro and Jaque Lemos are two fantastic YouTubers from my hometown, Gravatá, in the state of Pernambuco, Brazil. Together, they create a variety of sketch videos, always in the most comedic way possible, with many references from Brazilian Northeastern culture!

portfolio.title: RPG Character's Commission
portfolio.description: These are some of the best commissions created for a group of RPG players, ranging from D&D to Vampire: The Masquerade.

portfolio.title: Steven Universe's Fanart
portfolio.description: A personal project in which I created a fan art illustration based on the character Sardonyx from the animated series Steven Universe.

profile.name: MEET YANNE
profile.subtitle: \\\THE ARTIST BEHIND THE LAYOUT
bio: I'm a non-binary illustrator who believes the world looks way better when we draw on it.
With a degree in Design from UFPE (Brazil), I've focused my craft on children's illustration and character design, mixing communication and art in a playful style.
Whether I'm bringing whimsical flying guides to life or layouting books full of adventure, my focus is always on fun and representation. Let's have a talk and put your idea into a drawing?
